method_notes: BIC computed under independent-Gaussian likelihood assumption; substantial correlated noise remains (lag-1 AC ≈ 0.94), so effective sample size << n.
This is a descriptive comparison, not calibrated evidence for detection.
No uncalibrated p-value or formal detection significance is reported.

bic_comparison.assumption_warning: Independent-Gaussian likelihood is not reliable evidence given the measured correlated noise structure. Effective sample size is lower due to AC. Report for comparison only.

correlation_context.note: Residual autocorrelation indicates substantial correlated noise.

limitations_and_conclusions: Bootstrap and injection/recovery show stable ~154 ppm depth (95% CI ~150–158 ppm).
Fixed geometry dominates systematic uncertainty (~±5% depth).
BIC comparison reported with explicit unmodeled-correlation warning; not a formal detection claim.
No TESS S40/S53/S74 data available to complete cross-dataset validation.
